import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 25)

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    N = int(input())
    g = [[] for _ in range(N)]
    for _ in range(N - 1):
        a, b = map(int, input().split())
        a -= 1
        b -= 1
        g[a].append(b)
        g[b].append(a)

    # Bipartite coloring of the tree
    color = [-1] * N
    stack = [0]
    color[0] = 0
    cnt = [1, 0]

    while stack:
        v = stack.pop()
        for to in g[v]:
            if color[to] == -1:
                color[to] = color[v] ^ 1
                cnt[color[to]] += 1
                stack.append(to)

    # In a tree, vertices can be split into two independent sets.
    # Takahashi can guarantee a surviving white vertex iff one side
    # of the bipartition has strictly more than N//2 vertices.
    # Since he moves first, this is equivalent to max(cnt) > N//2.
    if max(cnt) > N // 2:
        print("First")
    else:
        print("Second")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
